description.en: The ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

description.zh:
是否强制删除共享带宽实例。取值： 
          
- **false**（默认值）：只删除不包含EIP的共享带宽。

- **true**：将共享带宽实例中的EIP全部移出后，删除共享带宽。
description.en:
Specifies whether to forcefully delete the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. Valid values:

*   **false** (default): deletes the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance only when no EIPs are associated with the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.
*   **true**: disassociates all EIPs from the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance and deletes the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

description.zh:
共享带宽实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance is created.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh: **DeleteCommonBandwidthPackage**接口不支持并发删除同一个共享带宽实例。
descriptions.en: You cannot repeatedly call the **DeleteCommonBandwidthPackage** operation to delete an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance within the specified period of time.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc delete-common-bandwidth-package --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-force false --bandwidth-package-id cbwp-2ze2ic1xd2qeqk145pn4u --region cn-hangzhou
